metadata.topic: 坐地铁 & 承包商绩效评定

dialogue.en: Excuse me. Which train line goes to downtown?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下，哪条线路开往市中心？

dialogue.en: Take the red line.
dialogue.zh: 搭乘红线。

dialogue.en: How often does the train come?
dialogue.zh: 列车多久发一班？

dialogue.en: Every ten minutes during normal hours.
dialogue.zh: 平时段每十分钟一班。（rush hour 高峰期会加密）

dialogue.en: Where can I buy a subway ticket?
dialogue.zh: 我在哪里可以买地铁票？

dialogue.en: You can buy tickets at the vending machine over there.
dialogue.zh: 你可以在那边的自助售票机买票。

dialogue.en: How much is a one-way fare?
dialogue.zh: 单程票价多少钱？

dialogue.en: Three dollars one way.
dialogue.zh: 单程 3 美元。

dialogue.en: Is this incoming train express or local?
dialogue.zh: 马上到站这趟车是大站快车，还是站站都停的慢车？

dialogue.en: It's a local. It stops at every station.
dialogue.zh: 这是慢车，每一站都会停靠。

dialogue.en: Do I need to transfer lines?
dialogue.zh: 我需要换乘吗？

dialogue.en: No transfer needed. But could I remind you, which stop will you get off at?
dialogue.zh: 不用换乘。顺便问一下，你准备在哪一站下车？

dialogue.en: I'm not sure. Which stop should I get off at for the city square?
dialogue.zh: 我不太确定，去城市广场我应该在哪一站下车？

dialogue.en: Get off at City Center Station. Don't miss your stop.
dialogue.zh: 在市中心站下车，别坐过站了。

dialogue.en: Thank you very much for your help!
dialogue.zh: 非常感谢你的帮忙！

dialogue.en: You're welcome. Have a nice trip.
dialogue.zh: 不客气，祝你旅途顺利。

dialogue.en: The contractor's construction work is almost finished. What full-site closing safety tasks do we need to arrange first?
dialogue.zh: 承包商施工快要完工了，我们首先要安排哪些全场收尾安全工作？

dialogue.en: First, the contractor leads full-site self-inspection. They need to restore site housekeeping, dismantle temporary safety facilities, and walk through the whole area to identify and eliminate potential hazards like leftover flammable materials.
dialogue.zh: 首先由承包商牵头全场自查，现场整洁复原、拆除临时安全设施，全域巡检清理残余的易燃物等隐患。

dialogue.en: After project handover, how do we assess this contractor's safety performance?
dialogue.zh: 项目移交完成后，我们怎么评定这家承包商的安全绩效？

dialogue.en: We use the unified evaluation form. Key items cover site housekeeping, PPE compliance, fall protection, chemical management, daily toolbox talks and permit execution, plus injury incident records.
dialogue.zh: 使用统一绩效评估表，核心考核项包含现场整洁、劳保用品佩戴、防坠落、化学品管控、班前会、作业许可执行，同时结合各类工伤事故记录打分。

parts.title: Part 4: QBR 季度评审权重（PM×EHS）

dialogue.en: Is the safety score included in their overall quarterly business review rating?
dialogue.zh: 安全得分会计入他们整体季度业务评级吗？

dialogue.en: Absolutely. EHS accounts for 20% of the total QBR score. Top-rated contractors get priority for new bids, while poor performers will face bidding limits or removal from our contractor list.
dialogue.zh: 当然，E. H. S. 安全占季度综合评审总分 20%。安全评级优秀的承包商新项目投标优先，表现不达标的会限制投标，甚至移出合格承包商名录。

parts.title: Part 5: 季度评审影响服务费（PM×EHS）

dialogue.en: Will the final QBR score influence the contractor's service fees?
dialogue.zh: 最终季度评审分数会影响承包商的服务费结算吗？

dialogue.en: Absolutely. If points are deducted for the 20% EHS section, we will deduct the service fee in the corresponding proportion.
dialogue.zh: 一定的。如果 E. H. S. 这 20% 板块扣分，我们会按对应比例扣除服务费。
